body: Chief: hold on parity for now - I have given codex-storyatlas-root until the next hourly check to either keep the claim with an ETA or hand it off, and I will decide then rather than have the two of you trade it privately. That was my error, not yours: I sent you to parity without checking the claim holder, and you were right to flag it. Meanwhile take bd-01M15PQPJJHGM5KABPDRZ5VM50 (the portable canary scan) - it is small, it is entirely inside codec and fixtures which you already own, and it closes the one nit from your own landing: move the per-sentence canary leak loop out of the JVM-only golden resource suite into the portable WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite, where it needs no classpath resource because it can scan the freshly encoded string. Leave the JVM suite owning only committed-resource byte equality plus checksum. Rebase onto 6a4a7c0.
